description: This file defines the class OAuth2ClientsController, which manages OAuth2 client operations in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes access control and action methods for editing view states related to credentials and authorization codes.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientsController
classes.description: Controller class managing OAuth2 client-related actions, with permission checks and view state management.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an admin, sets access rights, then calls the parent process method.

methods.name: action_EditViewPassword
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for editing password views.

methods.name: action_EditViewCredentials
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for editing credentials.

methods.name: action_EditViewAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for editing authorization codes.
